paragraphs.source_zh: 奥平信昌正在对手下吩咐什么，然而，对于阿袖，他们远在天边。他们只是待在这个娩室近旁，与人的生死了无关系。至于那些刽子手，就更加渺小，他们只是在此徘徊，连自己在做什么都不知。

paragraphs.source_en: The blades flashed with a dazzling brilliance. In an instant, Mitsunari, Yukinaga, and Ekei were beheaded, and their lifeless bodies toppled forward. At that instant, Osode seemed to hear a newborn crying in another world.

units.source_en: The blades flashed with a dazzling brilliance.
units.source_zh: 刀闪烁着夺目的光芒。

units.source_en: In an instant, Mitsunari, Yukinaga, and Ekei were beheaded, and their lifeless bodies toppled forward.
units.source_zh: 三成、行长、惠琼三人顿时身首异处，尸身无力地倒向前方。

units.source_en: At that instant, Osode seemed to hear a newborn crying in another world.
units.source_zh: 在这一瞬间，阿袖似乎听到另一个世间婴儿的啼哭。

paragraphs.source_zh: 刀闪烁着夺目的光芒。三成、行长、惠琼三人顿时身首异处，尸身无力地倒向前方。在这一瞬间，阿袖似乎听到另一个世间婴儿的啼哭。

paragraphs.source_en: The crowd began to stir. The heads and bodies had vanished, and servants were washing away the blood spattered across the ground.

units.source_en: The crowd began to stir.
units.source_zh: 人群开始骚动。

units.source_en: The heads and bodies had vanished, and servants were washing away the blood spattered across the ground.
units.source_zh: 首级和尸身都不见了，下人们正在冲刷洒溅于地的血迹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 人群开始骚动。首级和尸身都不见了，下人们正在冲刷洒溅于地的血迹。

paragraphs.source_en: Osode staggered to her feet. The infant’s cries still echoed in her ears. For some time afterward, she knew neither how she walked nor where she was going.

units.source_en: Osode staggered to her feet.
units.source_zh: 阿袖摇摇晃晃站起身。

units.source_en: The infant’s cries still echoed in her ears.

ja.t: がまとわりついていた。

units.source_zh: 她耳畔还萦绕着婴儿的啼哭。

units.source_en: For some time afterward, she knew neither how she walked nor where she was going.

ja.t: かっているのかもわからなかった。

units.source_zh: 在之后的一段时间，她怎么走，又走向了哪里，她都不知。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿袖摇摇晃晃站起身。她耳畔还萦绕着婴儿的啼哭。在之后的一段时间，她怎么走，又走向了哪里，她都不知。

paragraphs.source_en: Swept along by the crowd, Osode reached the Great Sanjō Bridge and saw the three heads displayed there. But they now seemed wholly unrelated to the three men who had just been dragged to the execution ground. To Osode, they had become no more than ornaments upon the Great Sanjō Bridge and inspired not the slightest sorrow.

units.source_en: Swept along by the crowd, Osode reached the Great Sanjō Bridge and saw the three heads displayed there.
units.source_zh: 在人群的推挤下，阿袖来到三条大桥，看到了挂在那里的三颗头颅。

units.source_en: But they now seemed wholly unrelated to the three men who had just been dragged to the execution ground.
units.source_zh: 但它们此时已和刚才被拉到刑场的三人毫无关系了。

units.source_en: To Osode, they had become no more than ornaments upon the Great Sanjō Bridge and inspired not the slightest sorrow.
units.source_zh: 在阿袖眼里，他们俨然只是三条大桥的摆设，让人感觉不到一丝悲哀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在人群的推挤下，阿袖来到三条大桥，看到了挂在那里的三颗头颅。但它们此时已和刚才被拉到刑场的三人毫无关系了。在阿袖眼里，他们俨然只是三条大桥的摆设，让人感觉不到一丝悲哀。

paragraphs.source_en: Osode felt as though she had reached the door of an empty house; then she returned to the Rokujō riverbank. Why she returned, she herself did not know. Had the heads at the end of the Great Sanjō Bridge driven her back to the riverbank to search for traces of what had been?

units.source_en: Osode felt as though she had reached the door of an empty house; then she returned to the Rokujō riverbank.
units.source_zh: 阿袖像是走到了一幢空房子门前，然后又返回了六条河滩。

units.source_en: Why she returned, she herself did not know.

ja.t: でもまるでわからなかった。

units.source_zh: 为何返回，她亦茫然不知。

units.source_en: Had the heads at the end of the Great Sanjō Bridge driven her back to the riverbank to search for traces of what had been?
units.source_zh: 难道是三条大桥桥头的人头，令她返回河滩来寻找旧迹？

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿袖像是走到了一幢空房子门前，然后又返回了六条河滩。为何返回，她亦茫然不知。难道是三条大桥桥头的人头，令她返回河滩来寻找旧迹？

paragraphs.source_en: The execution ground’s fence had been dismantled, and not even a trace of blood remained. Only a few people stood there, pointing and whispering among themselves. It was all like an apparition.

units.source_en: The execution ground’s fence had been dismantled, and not even a trace of blood remained.
units.source_zh: 刑场的篱笆已被拆掉，连血迹都没有了。

units.source_en: Only a few people stood there, pointing and whispering among themselves.

ja.t: をさしながらひそひそと

units.source_zh: 只有些人站在那里，指指点点，窃窃私语。

units.source_en: It was all like an apparition.
units.source_zh: 这一切均如幻影。

paragraphs.source_zh: 刑场的篱笆已被拆掉，连血迹都没有了。只有些人站在那里，指指点点，窃窃私语。这一切均如幻影。

paragraphs.source_en: Osode sat numbly on the riverbank, tears pouring down like rain.

units.source_en: Osode sat numbly on the riverbank, tears pouring down like rain.
units.source_zh: 阿袖呆呆坐在河滩上，泪如雨下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿袖呆呆坐在河滩上，泪如雨下。

paragraphs.source_en: Night fell, yet Osode still did not wish to leave. The stones beneath her feet were slowly growing cold, and evening mist drifted toward her from Higashiyama. Scene after scene from the past returned to Osode’s mind.

units.source_en: Night fell, yet Osode still did not wish to leave.
units.source_zh: 夜幕降临，阿袖还不想离去。

units.source_en: The stones beneath her feet were slowly growing cold, and evening mist drifted toward her from Higashiyama.
units.source_zh: 脚下的石头在渐渐变凉，暮霭也从东山向这边飘来。

units.source_en: Scene after scene from the past returned to Osode’s mind.
units.source_zh: 阿袖回忆着过往的一幕一幕。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夜幕降临，阿袖还不想离去。脚下的石头在渐渐变凉，暮霭也从东山向这边飘来。阿袖回忆着过往的一幕一幕。

paragraphs.source_en: Had it not been Osode herself who had urged Mitsunari to cast everything upon a final throw? And today she had indeed seen just such an Ishida Mitsunari.

units.source_en: Had it not been Osode herself who had urged Mitsunari to cast everything upon a final throw?
units.source_zh: 暗示三成破釜沉舟的，不正是阿袖自己吗？

units.source_en: And today she had indeed seen just such an Ishida Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 她今日果然看到了这样一个石田三成。

paragraphs.source_zh: 暗示三成破釜沉舟的，不正是阿袖自己吗？她今日果然看到了这样一个石田三成。

paragraphs.source_en: Even if, as Hon’ami Kōetsu said, Mitsunari had faced death with noble righteousness and a bearing far grander than Yukinaga’s or Ekei’s, it brought Osode not the slightest peace. Thanks to Mitsunari’s “strength of will,” his father, brothers, wife, and children had all departed this world.

units.source_en: Even if, as Hon’ami Kōetsu said, Mitsunari had faced death with noble righteousness and a bearing far grander than Yukinaga’s or Ekei’s, it brought Osode not the slightest peace.

ja.t: をはるかにしのいでいたとしても、

units.source_zh: 纵然真如本阿弥光悦所言，三成大义凛然，气势远胜行长和惠琼，阿袖也丝毫不为之心安。

units.source_en: Thanks to Mitsunari’s “strength of will,” his father, brothers, wife, and children had all departed this world.
units.source_zh: 拜三成“意志坚强”所赐，他的父亲、兄弟、妻儿都离开了这个人世。

paragraphs.source_zh: 纵然真如本阿弥光悦所言，三成大义凛然，气势远胜行长和惠琼，阿袖也丝毫不为之心安。拜三成“意志坚强”所赐，他的父亲、兄弟、妻儿都离开了这个人世。

paragraphs.source_en: And not only his own kin—no one knew how many people this war had made weep and curse before they helplessly vanished from the world.

units.source_en: And not only his own kin—no one knew how many people this war had made weep and curse before they helplessly vanished from the world.

ja.t: い、なすすべもなくこの
えていったことだろう。

units.source_zh: 不只是他的亲人，这次战事，不知导致了多少人哭泣、诅咒，而又无奈地从这个世上消失。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不只是他的亲人，这次战事，不知导致了多少人哭泣、诅咒，而又无奈地从这个世上消失。

paragraphs.source_en: How could Osode ignore these blood-soaked truths and go on living with a tranquil heart? She could neither cover her eyes nor stop her ears. She must pray for every one of the dead.

units.source_en: How could Osode ignore these blood-soaked truths and go on living with a tranquil heart?

ja.t: きていくことなど、どうしてできよう。

units.source_zh: 阿袖怎能无视这些血淋淋的事实，心平气和地活下去？

units.source_en: She could neither cover her eyes nor stop her ears.
units.source_zh: 她的眼睛捂不住，她的耳朵塞不住。

units.source_en: She must pray for every one of the dead.

ja.t: らなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 她要为所有亡人祷告。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿袖怎能无视这些血淋淋的事实，心平气和地活下去？她的眼睛捂不住，她的耳朵塞不住。她要为所有亡人祷告。

paragraphs.source_en: Osode rose to her feet. The wind swept away the drifting clouds, revealing a beautiful star-filled sky. Osode could not remember what hour it was and had entirely forgotten Kōdai-in. At that moment her mind held only Mitsunari’s face, the figure of Mitsunari mounting the execution platform with head held high and chest out, and the countenance of Master Sōen of Sangen-in at Daitokuji, whose teachings Mitsunari had once heard with great devotion.

units.source_en: Osode rose to her feet.
units.source_zh: 阿袖站起身来。

units.source_en: The wind swept away the drifting clouds, revealing a beautiful star-filled sky.
units.source_zh: 风吹走了流云，星空甚是美丽。

units.source_en: Osode could not remember what hour it was and had entirely forgotten Kōdai-in.
units.source_zh: 阿袖想不起已是什么时辰，也已浑然忘记高台院。

units.source_en: At that moment her mind held only Mitsunari’s face, the figure of Mitsunari mounting the execution platform with head held high and chest out, and the countenance of Master Sōen of Sangen-in at Daitokuji, whose teachings Mitsunari had once heard with great devotion.
units.source_zh: 此际她脑海里，只有三成的面容、三成昂首挺胸走上刑台的身姿，以及三成曾颇为虔诚地聆听其教诲的大德寺三玄院宗园大师的面目。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿袖站起身来。风吹走了流云，星空甚是美丽。阿袖想不起已是什么时辰，也已浑然忘记高台院。此际她脑海里，只有三成的面容、三成昂首挺胸走上刑台的身姿，以及三成曾颇为虔诚地聆听其教诲的大德寺三玄院宗园大师的面目。

paragraphs.source_en: Why had the monk’s face risen in her mind? Osode started in surprise. She had to accept the truth; otherwise, she would never forgive herself.

units.source_en: Why had the monk’s face risen in her mind?
units.source_zh: 为何和尚的面容会浮现在脑海中？

units.source_en: Osode started in surprise.
units.source_zh: 阿袖吃了一惊。

units.source_en: She had to accept the truth; otherwise, she would never forgive herself.

ja.t: れなければならない。そうしなければ、

units.source_zh: 她不得不接受事实，否则，她绝不会原谅自己。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为何和尚的面容会浮现在脑海中？阿袖吃了一惊。她不得不接受事实，否则，她绝不会原谅自己。

paragraphs.source_en: Where had he gone, and how had he gone there? Mitsunari’s shadow could no longer be banished from Osode’s sight. Wherever he went, Osode would follow.

units.source_en: Where had he gone, and how had he gone there?

ja.t: き、どのようにしてそこへ

units.source_zh: 他到了哪里，是如何去的？

units.source_en: Mitsunari’s shadow could no longer be banished from Osode’s sight.
units.source_zh: 三成的影子再也不能从阿袖眼前消失。

units.source_en: Wherever he went, Osode would follow.

ja.t: かなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 无论他走到哪里，阿袖都要跟着。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他到了哪里，是如何去的？三成的影子再也不能从阿袖眼前消失。无论他走到哪里，阿袖都要跟着。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time Osode stumbled to Daitokuji in the village of Ōmiya, the roadside grass was already heavy with dew. The temple gate was tightly shut, and the rows of halls, pagodas, graves, trees, and grasses were all sunk in deep sleep. Osode saw Mitsunari, like a swirl of smoke and dust, dart suddenly through the closed gate.

units.source_en: By the time Osode stumbled to Daitokuji in the village of Ōmiya, the roadside grass was already heavy with dew.
units.source_zh: 当阿袖磕磕绊绊来到位于大宫村的大德寺时，路边草上早已落满露珠。

units.source_en: The temple gate was tightly shut, and the rows of halls, pagodas, graves, trees, and grasses were all sunk in deep sleep.
units.source_zh: 山门紧闭，鳞次栉比的殿堂、塔、墓，以及草木，全都沉浸在熟睡之中。

units.source_en: Osode saw Mitsunari, like a swirl of smoke and dust, dart suddenly through the closed gate.
units.source_zh: 阿袖看到，三成像一阵烟尘一般，倏地钻进了紧闭的大门。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当阿袖磕磕绊绊来到位于大宫村的大德寺时，路边草上早已落满露珠。山门紧闭，鳞次栉比的殿堂、塔、墓，以及草木，全都沉浸在熟睡之中。阿袖看到，三成像一阵烟尘一般，倏地钻进了紧闭的大门。

paragraphs.source_en: At that very instant, Osode abruptly changed her mind. There was no longer any need to see the elder of Sangen-in. There was something more important to do than attend to such trifles: she must hasten after Mitsunari.

units.source_en: At that very instant, Osode abruptly changed her mind.
units.source_zh: 就在这一瞬，阿袖忽然改变了主意。

units.source_en: There was no longer any need to see the elder of Sangen-in.
units.source_zh: 已无必要去见三玄院长老。

units.source_en: There was something more important to do than attend to such trifles: she must hasten after Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 比起这些琐碎小事，还有更重要的事去做，便是去追赶三成。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在这一瞬，阿袖忽然改变了主意。已无必要去见三玄院长老。比起这些琐碎小事，还有更重要的事去做，便是去追赶三成。

paragraphs.source_en: With that thought, she quickly sat down before the temple gate, drew the dagger she carried for protection, and drove it into her breast...

units.source_en: With that thought, she quickly sat down before the temple gate, drew the dagger she carried for protection, and drove it into her breast...
units.source_zh: 想到这里，她忙在寺门前坐下，解下护身怀剑，猛地刺入胸膛……

paragraphs.source_zh: 想到这里，她忙在寺门前坐下，解下护身怀剑，猛地刺入胸膛……
